text_block_list.text:
One day, Bubble Gum Fellow was dancing in 
the plaza.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she's at it again today. Man, it's 
downright dazzling, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Practicing for a live show or something?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nah, nah, it's actually got a pretty 
complicated story behind it...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Aahhh! Usapii got a collab project?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, amazing, isn't it? A collab between 
a nationally beloved mascot and a super 
famous apparel brand. No wonder it's 
causing such a buzz.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Man, I'm so jealous... A collab with 
Usapii...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Could I get one if I become famous? 
No... maybe if doing a collab boosts 
recognition for both of us, just maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'm making a declaration!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to collab with Usapii no matter 
what"!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And so, to get nominated by Usapii, she's 
currently promoting herself on social 
media.

Usapii... It's a famous mascot seen on 
stationery and plushies. It's hard to 
imagine the official account responding to 
an individual, though...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Nature! Could you help me with the 
filming?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah, sure, sure. Guess I'll head over.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, what on earth is this background?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this? I made it! Flashy backgrounds 
make thumbnails pop way more, you know. 
Plus, it's portable!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You *made* it?! That's crazy!! A-Alright, 
let's shoot. 3, 2, 1...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, with that kind of passion, it 
wouldn't surprise me if it actually 
reached the official account~.

Just as Nature said, her enthusiasm was 
incredible. But still, pulling this off 
seemed almost impossible...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I hope she isn't feeling too down, 
though...
choice_data_list: Are you talking about Bubble Gum Fellow?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She hasn't posted any updates on 
social media lately...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

Just then, Bubble Gum Fellow suddenly 
appeared! A mountain of backdrops lay 
stacked at her feet.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, perfect timing! There's something I 
want to do, so could you film for me 
again?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind, but... what are you planning 
to do?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I realized something! Just decorating 
flashy thumbnails isn't enough to reach 
Usapii! So—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make a mosaic art of Usapii 
using all my video thumbnails!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If it's something brand new that no one's 
ever tried before, it's bound to reach 
Usapii!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So I've been building this mosaic art for 
a while now... but I ran out of materials!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just as expected of you, Bubble-san. All 
right, I'll give you a hand.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Everyone knows that cute little cutie~♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Loves all things fluffy, U-sa-py!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I love you♡ Usapy—!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now if I just fit in the clips we 
just took and polish it up~...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And there! The mosaic art of Usapy is 
complete!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, incredible! It really looks like 
Usapy!

Looking closely, the flashy thumbnails 
uploaded so far come together to form 
Usapy's silhouette. With quality like 
this, maybe...

Some time passed after that with no word. 
Even so, Bubble Gum Fellow kept working 
hard on filming her videos as always. When 
suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait! Look at the comments on 
the mosaic art video!

text_block_list.name: Usapy
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the wonderful dance! Usapy 
would love to dance with you someday 
too~♪"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Wah—! This is the real Usapy, right?! 
Ahaha! They said they want to dance with 
me!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Faced with that much passion, even the 
official team couldn't stay quiet, huh~
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to the collab.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Faced with that much passion, even the 
official team couldn't stay quiet, huh~
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to the collab.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just you wait! I'll make it the absolute 
best collab ever!

In her mind, the collab is already set in 
stone. That boundless optimism is so like 
her. I can't help but be impressed.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Don't tell me you're starting to love 
Usapy too, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: I just got interested after watching you.
I just got interested after watching you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That's... totally awesome! That means my 
efforts managed to convey Usapy's charm to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Aah, I'm so glad I gave it my all~! I can 
keep pushing forward at this rate!
